plain_english: Yoginī-born or Rudra — neither plainly wins this heart of the god of gods, swift giver of yoga's release.
sanskrit_cite: etan nā yoginījāto nā rudro labhate sphuṭam | hṛdayaṃ devadevasya sadyo yogavimokṣadam

plain_english: At its right utterance, the great host of mantra-seals comes face to face at once — marked by possession of one's own body.
sanskrit_cite: asyoccāre kṛte samyaṅ mantramudrāgaṇo mahān | sadyaḥ sanmukhatām eti svadehāveśalakṣaṇam

plain_english: Who remembers for a moment, in the kiss, navel-sealed — he binds body then, and the mantra-seal host, the man.
sanskrit_cite: muhūrtaṃ smarate yas tu cumbake nābhimudritaḥ | sa badhnāti tadā dehaṃ mantramudrāgaṇaṃ naraḥ

plain_english: Asked, he tells past and future things — even within three hours, uttering the meant god-form.
sanskrit_cite: atītānāgatānarthān pṛṣṭo 'sau kathayaty api | praharād yad abhipretaṃ devatārūpam uccaran

plain_english: Face to face he sees the undoubted, drawn by Rudra's powers; in two watches' time, sky-dwelling, remembering.
sanskrit_cite: sakṣāt paśyaty asaṃdigdham ākṛṣṭaṃ rudrasaktibhiḥ | praharadvayamātreṇa vyomastho jāyate smaran

plain_english: By three: all mothers, mighty yoginīs, heroes, hero-lords, adepts, and the strong śākinī throng.
sanskrit_cite: trayeṇa mātaraḥ sarvā yogesvaryo mahābalāḥ | vīrā vīresvarāḥ siddhā balavān śākinīgaṇaḥ

plain_english: Come, pledged, urged by Bhairava — they grant supreme fruition, whatever fruit is wished.
sanskrit_cite: āgatya samayaṃ dattvā bhairaveṇa pracoditāḥ | yacchanti paramāṃ siddhiṃ phalaṃ yad vā samīhitam

plain_english: By this the perfected will perfect, and make mantra-men perfect.
sanskrit_cite: anena siddhāḥ setsyanti sādhayanti ca mantriṇaḥ

plain_english: Whatever in Bhairava's Tantra succeeds from this — by mantra-potency's possession-power, with no controller.
sanskrit_cite: yatkiṃcid bhairave tantre sarvam asmāt prasidhyati | mantravīryasamāveśaprabhāvān na niyantriṇā
